title: The Three Chapters at the Fifth Council
english: I read the Acts of the Fifth Council, in which the so-called Three Chapters were taken up: those concerning Origen — he himself and his writings were anathematized — and those concerning Diodorus of Tarsus and Theodore of Mopsuestia, who were likewise anathematized.

Theodoret's twelve chapters written against Cyril's were also anathematized. Some sessions had also been held before this, about Zooras and about Anthimus of Trebizond, who had slipped into the throne of Constantinople, together with certain other matters included with these.
translator_notes: Greek locked from Bekker 1824 p.5 (IA leaf n16). Line-break on ἐτραγματεύθη flagged in the lock.
Codex 18 of 279; Fifth Council = Constantinople II (553). The Three Chapters; Anthimus of Trebizond had occupied the see of Constantinople.
